about: One table welds the pre-rite kūkulu reading: rite-command.test.ts reads each row through kukuluHand (rite-kukulu.ts) and through riteKukulu itself with no terminal; tools/lares-container.test.mjs plants the same facts behind the shim's `pulama status` and reads its line. Unnamed facts read vessel standing, current false, admitted false, offer false. `lei`: true (a return left), "absent", "returns-spent", or null (unread).

rows.name: level-no-lei
rows.line: needs your hand: no standing kukulu lei (the pūlama's admit of the new image reads your route)

rows.name: level-spent
rows.line: needs your hand: the kukulu lei's returns lie spent

rows.name: level-down
rows.line: needs your hand: no vessel stands to begin the rite (the pūlama's admit of the new image reads your route)

rows.name: level-unlit
rows.line: needs your hand: the pūlama stands unlit

rows.name: level-unread
rows.line: reads unknown: whether the pūlama stands lit, or what it runs (read it with `lares pulama status`)

rows.name: absent
rows.line: needs your hand: no pūlama runs

rows.name: moved-lei-path-off
rows.line: needs your hand: closure moved; keeper lei path off

rows.name: moved-no-lei
rows.line: needs your hand: closure moved; no standing kukulu lei

rows.name: moved-struck
rows.line: needs your hand: closure moved; struck due

rows.name: moved-vests
rows.line: keeper vests under your keeper commit

rows.name: moved-vests-no-lei
rows.line: needs your hand: closure moved; no standing kukulu lei

rows.name: moved-keeper-lei
rows.line: keeper vests under the standing lei

rows.name: moved-keeper-lei-no-lei
rows.line: needs your hand: closure moved; no standing kukulu lei
